**Is your feature request related to a problem? Please describe.**
A clear and concise description of the motivation or user friction (e.g. "Customers cannot filter cards by grading tier").

**Proposed Solution**
Describe the requested functionality and how it fits into the current architecture.

**Technical Considerations**
- [ ] Backend API Changes (DTO, Service, Controller, JPA Query)
- [ ] Database Schema Migration (PostgreSQL / Supabase DDL)
- [ ] Frontend State / UI Component (React 19 / Vite)
- [ ] Security / Authentication Requirements
- [ ] Automated Test Coverage (JUnit 5 / Integration tests)

**Alternatives Considered**
Describe alternative designs, trade-offs, or libraries evaluated.

**Additional Context**
Add any mockups, screenshots, or reference specifications here.
